Standalone DOCX extraction using extract

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"filename\":\"fake.docx\",\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/docx/fake.docx\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].content())
```
